body { /* Set "section" to 0 */ counter-reset: section; padding: 0 5vmin; } h2 { line-height: 1.3; counter-reset: subsection; } section { width: 100%; } .izq { width: 50%; float: left; } .der { margin-top: 2em; } p, ol, pre { -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; font-weight: bold; font-size: 0.98rem; font-family: "Courier New", monospace; tab-size: 12; -o-tab-size: 12; -moz-tab-size: 12; } ol li { /* Set "subsection" to 0 */ counter-increment: section; } pre { margin-left: 0; } ol ol { margin: 0 0 1.5em -10px; } @media (max-width: 1050px) { .izq { width: 100%; } p { font-size: 0.9rem; word-spacing: -25%; } } hr.shadow { height: 10px; border: 0; box-shadow: 0 10px 10px -10px #808080 inset; }
